title: 第25章 丹圣手札剑爷的震惊第26章 好圣孙九彩琉璃焱楚家上门
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
“真搞不懂你。”剑爷表示十分不能理解。
甚至怀疑这丫头是不是傻的有点问题。
“这七彩香莲你精心培育了那么久，总共才三株，这小子倒好，直接给你摘了，只差一点就可以成熟的，倒是可惜了。”
洛珺仙不语，只是在天字后面又一笔一划的写下了又一个娟秀的字迹。
不多不少，刚刚十五画。
“喂，丫头，你到底有没有在听，他就这么把你的心血毁掉当成一个装饰品戴在你头上，难道你不生气吗。”剑爷还在挑拨离间。
洛珺仙停下指头，抬手摸了摸被当做发簪挽起发丝的七彩香莲。
檀香小口轻启，纠正道：
“这是礼物。”
剑爷：“······”
不玩了，走了。
真烦人！
洛珺仙神色动了动，忽的开口问道：“剑爷，那丹道真解果真来历不凡吗？”
提起这个，剑爷倒是来了兴趣。
眉飞色舞起来。
“当然，还能骗你不成，估计至少也是一尊丹圣的拓本手札。”
“你可别小瞧了这看起来破破烂烂的玩意儿，要是消息走漏出去的话，你信不信随便来一个人就可以轻易覆灭掉你们这边缘小王国。”
洛珺仙神色微微动容起来，清冷的声音中泛起了一丝急促。
“可这么珍贵的东西又怎么会出现在我萧家的？”
剑爷摇头晃脑，“这我就不知道了，但世间之事皆有命数，尤其是这种大机缘，在冥冥之中是会遵循天道指引，主动寻找福泽旺盛者的。”

“与其说是你们萧家人主动找来放置在这里的。”
“倒不如说是，你们萧家只是遵循了某种定数，将其取来暂时寄放于此，等候真正的有缘人罢了。”
“而恰巧，这小子就是那有缘人。”
“啧啧，这就是连天道都要眷顾的人吗，有大气运大机缘加持，这身天赋还万古独步，简直绝了！”
洛珺仙黛眉紧蹙，在思考这番言语。
“听不懂吗，那你说这东西在你们萧家存放多久了？”
“有几百年了吧。”
“几百年间，可曾有谁识得其真名？”
洛珺仙沉默不语，随后似是恍然。
“以你的天赋都看不穿这丹道真解，只能勉强记忆，只能说明你根本就不适合它。”
洛珺仙陷入回忆中。
之前叶天澜就将这竹简拿出来给她看过。
和叶天澜不同，她只能勉强辨认那竹简上所记载的是文字，但却十分模糊，根本看不清。
有着很大的阅读障碍。
“剑爷，那你说他能修炼成功吗。”她将目光投到房间里面，话语中隐含着一丝担忧。
残缺玉剑一阵摇晃，光芒明灭不定。
“难啊我估计，毕竟这小子没什么底子，又没有什么师傅前辈领路，全靠自己琢磨怎么可能完全领悟一名丹圣留下的炼丹手札。”
“之前我听他给你念叨一遍的时候记住了一些，这机缘的确十分巨大，即便在我看来也是如此，万万没想到居然是引导人凝炼本命丹火的。”
丹火，乃是炼丹师的本源之火。
可以说一名炼丹师有多高的水准，八成都体现在了自身的丹火之上。

一名强大的资深炼丹师，其本命丹火就绝对不会弱。
否则连炼化材料都成问题，那还炼什么丹药，即便是手法再高，神魂之力再强也没有任何作用。
content_en:
"I really don't understand you." Mr. Jian said that he couldn't understand it at all.
I even wondered if there was something wrong with this girl being stupid.
"You have carefully cultivated these seven-color fragrant lotuses for so long. There are only three of them in total. It's a good thing that this guy picked them for you directly. They are only a little short of reaching maturity. It's a pity."
Luo Junxian said nothing, but wrote another beautiful handwriting after the word "天".
No more, no less, just fifteen paintings.
"Hey, girl, are you listening? He just ruined your hard work and put it on your head as a decoration. Aren't you angry?" Mr. Jian was still sowing discord.
Luo Junxian stopped his fingers and raised his hand to touch the colorful lotus used as a hairpin to hold up his hair.
Sandalwood opened her mouth slightly and corrected:
"This is a gift."
Master Jian: “·······”
No more playing, let’s go.
How annoying!
Immortal Luo Jun's expression changed, and he suddenly asked: "Master Jian, is that true solution to the alchemy path really of extraordinary origin?"
Mentioning this, Master Jian became interested.
His eyebrows danced with joy.
"Of course, I can still lie to you. I guess it's at least the rubbings of an alchemy saint."
"Don't underestimate this shabby-looking thing. If the news leaks out, do you believe that just one person can easily destroy your small kingdom on the edge?"
Luo Junxian's expression changed slightly, and there was a hint of urgency in his cold voice.
"But how could such a precious thing appear in my Xiao family?"
Master Jian shook his head, "I don't know about this, but everything in this world has its destiny, especially for such a great opportunity. In the dark, people will follow the guidance of heaven and actively look for those with great blessings."
"It's not so much that you, the Xiao family, took the initiative to find it and place it here."
"It would be better to say that your Xiao family just followed a certain order and took it to temporarily store it here, waiting for the real destiny."
"And it just so happens that this kid is the destined one."
"Tsk, tsk, is this the person that even heaven will favor? With the blessing of great luck and great opportunity, this talent is unparalleled forever, it is simply unparalleled!"
Luojun Xiandai frowned, thinking about these words.
"Don't you understand? How long do you think this thing has been stored in your Xiao family?"
"It must have been hundreds of years."
"In the past few hundred years, has anyone ever known his true name?"
Luo Junxian was silent, and then seemed to suddenly realize.
"With your talent, you can't see through the true meaning of this alchemy. You can only barely remember it, which only shows that you are not suitable for it at all."
Luo Junxian fell into memories.
Ye Tianlan had taken out this bamboo slip and showed it to her before.
Unlike Ye Tianlan, she could barely identify that what was recorded on the bamboo slips was writing, but it was very blurry and could not be seen clearly at all.
Has severe dyslexia.
"Master Jian, do you think he can succeed in cultivation?" She cast her gaze into the room, with a trace of worry hidden in her words.
The incomplete jade sword shook for a while, and the light flickered on and off.
"It's difficult, I guess. After all, this kid has no foundation and no senior master to lead the way. He has to figure out how he can fully understand the alchemy handbook left by an alchemy sage."
"I remembered some of it when I listened to him reciting it to you before. This opportunity is indeed very huge, even in my opinion. I never expected that it would lead people to condense their natal elixir fire."
Dan fire is the original fire of the alchemist.
It can be said that how high an alchemist is, 80% of it is reflected in his own alchemy fire.
A powerful senior alchemist's natal elixir fire will never be weak.
Otherwise, even refining materials will be a problem, so why refine elixirs? No matter how advanced the technique is, no matter how strong the power of the soul is, it will have no effect.
